correctness.rationale: The child-lifting U is an isometry, and S*=UD with D constant sqrt(b_n) on each depth. Orthogonal wandering spaces decompose S* into weighted unilateral forward channels with cyclic shifts of the period. Each shifted unilateral minimum modulus agrees with the bilateral one: zero extension bounds it below and translation of finite-period bilateral test vectors proves reverse inequality. Floquet fiber C(θ)-rI is bounded below in norm by C(0)-rI on coordinatewise absolute values, and θ=0 attains the bound. Thus exactly m(S*-bar λ)=sigma_min(C-|λ|I); its zero occurs at r_*=(∏w_j)^(1/p). Hilbert closed-range theorem gives onto and right-inverse constant off this circle, with dense nonclosed range on it. Simple Perron right a and left a^-1 yield first singular slope L=p/(||a||||a^-1||), L=1 iff weights constant. Period-four substitution gives L_alt=2sqrt(q)/(1+q) and L_cluster=4q/(1+q)² with q=sqrt(d). Finite 1238 cyclic/twist/critical checks are corroboration only.
residual_risks: Proof requires periodic level-homogeneous positive integer branching; not for arbitrary irregular tree or uniform over unbounded period.
